app.tagline: Video and music from YouTube and over a thousand other sites, in a couple of clicks
header.clipboard.tip: Copy a video link in your browser and it appears here by itself
header.update.tip: Get the newest yt-dlp; it helps when a site has changed something
input.hint: Paste links or names, one per line. Enter adds them
input.help: Ctrl+V anywhere in the window  ·  drop a link, list or table  ·  names are found by themselves  ·  playlists and channels expand into a list
queue.title: Queue
empty.title: The queue is empty
empty.line1: Works with YouTube, SoundCloud, Vimeo, TikTok and over a thousand other sites: just paste a link.
empty.line2: Or type names as a list: videos and songs are found by themselves.
empty.pill2: Drop a link into the window
card.nooriginal: no original found, using a video · “{0}”
card.original.tip: The studio recording from YouTube Music, without the sound of a music video
card.exists: Already in the folder, will be skipped
card.versions.tip: Several versions were found; click to choose another
card.mode.tip: Audio or video, and its quality, for this one only
settings.original: Original track instead of the clip
settings.original.hint: The studio recording, for YouTube links and song names
settings.original.tip: For audio, takes the studio recording from YouTube Music rather than the sound of a clip with its intros, dialogue and noises. If there is none, the video is used and its non-music parts are cut using SponsorBlock data.
settings.cover.hint: The preview becomes the file's cover
settings.subs.hint: In your system's language and in English, automatic ones included
settings.openafter: Open the folder at the end
settings.openafter.hint: When the whole queue has finished
settings.sound.hint: Plays when the queue has finished
settings.language.restart: The language changes after a restart.
settings.proxy.note: Saved unless it holds a password. A proxy with a password lasts until the app closes.
status.list.detail: Press Download all when you are ready
log.title: Log
drop.title: Drop to add
drop.detail: Links, a list of songs, or a library file
picker.title: Choose a version
picker.detail: Click a version to put it on the card. You can edit the search and look again.
picker.count: Versions: {0}. Click the one you want.
picker.none: Nothing found. Edit the search and press Find.
auth.tip: Needed for age-restricted and private videos, on any site
auth.tip.signedin: Age-restricted and private videos download through your accounts. Click to change it or sign out.
auth.title: Sign in
auth.detail: Needed for age-restricted and private videos. Volna uses the sign-ins of the browser you already use, on every site, so you normally just pick it.
auth.nobrowser: No supported browser was found on this computer.
auth.separate.tip: For browsers that do not share their sign-ins, such as Chrome on Windows: opens a separate window with its own profile, where you sign in to YouTube once.
auth.privacy: Your passwords never reach this program. Cookies are read locally and sent only to the sites they belong to. Very frequent mass downloads can get an account limited for a while; if that matters, use a second account.
auth.notsignedin: Now using the sign-ins of {0}. It is not signed in to YouTube, though. If you need that, sign in there and try again. If you have just signed in to Firefox, close it first: it saves new sign-ins when it closes.
auth.cannotread: {0} does not let other programs read its sign-ins. Close it and try again, or use a separate window.
auth.cannotread.safari: macOS protects Safari's cookies. Give Volna Full Disk Access in System Settings, or choose another browser.
auth.separate.wait: Sign in in the window that opened. With Firefox, close the window afterwards; other browsers close by themselves.
auth.separate.fail: No sign-in was found in that window.
auth.separate.none: {0} cannot open a separate window here.
auth.file.bad: This file has no cookies in it.
auth.signedout: Signed out here. Your browser stays signed in.
setup.title: One moment: setting up
setup.detail: Volna uses yt-dlp, FFmpeg and Deno. They come from the releases of those projects and are checked before use. This happens once and takes up about 450 MB.
tools.badhash: {0} did not match its published checksum and was discarded.
toast.throttled: The site asked to slow down. Continuing in {0} s
toast.throttled.signin: The site asked to slow down. Continuing in {0} s. This happens less often when signed in
toast.needlogin: Some videos need a sign-in: press Sign in at the top
toast.duplicates: Skipped {0} duplicates already in the list
toast.empty: Add links or song names first
toast.alldone: Everything is already finished or downloading
toast.exists: This file is already in the folder, so it was not downloaded again
toast.stillactive: Active downloads remain; stop them first
toast.stopped: Stopped. Unfinished files can be continued with retry
toast.done.errors: Downloaded: {0}, failed: {1}. Hover over an error to read all of it
toast.versiontaken: This version is already in the list
toast.signedin: Signed in: age-restricted and private videos are now available
toast.signedin.retry: Signed in: age-restricted and private videos are now available. Retrying: {0}
toast.already: This is already in the list
toast.already.many: All of this is already in the list
toast.typesomething: Paste a link or type a song name
toast.clipboardbusy: Another program is holding the clipboard. Try again
toast.wait.update: Wait for the downloads to finish, then update
toast.update.failed: Could not update yt-dlp; see the log
toast.clipboard.on: Copy a video link in your browser and it will appear here
close.title: Downloads are running
close.detail: Stop them and close Volna? Unfinished files can be continued later.
status.waitlimit: Waiting: the site asked to slow down, will retry by itself
error.age: Age-restricted: a sign-in is needed. Press Sign in at the top.
error.age.signedin: Age-restricted: this account has not confirmed its age, or the sign-in is out of date. Sign in again.
error.bot: The site wants a sign-in. Press Sign in at the top.
error.bot.signedin: The site wants proof you are not a bot. Sign in again or try later.
error.cookiefile: The cookies file must be in Netscape cookies.txt format.
error.cookielocked: The browser is holding its cookies. Close it and try again.
error.cookiedecrypt: The browser does not let other programs read its sign-ins. Press Sign in and use a separate window.
error.private: A sign-in is needed. Press Sign in at the top.
error.private.signedin: Your account has no access to this video.
error.unavailable: This video is unavailable: removed, hidden, or the link is wrong.
error.notfound: Nothing found. Try a more exact name.
error.unsupported: This site or kind of link is not supported.
error.format: The chosen quality is not available. Try Highest.
error.throttled: The site asked to slow down. Try again in a while.
error.update: The site refused the download. Press Update yt-dlp and try again.
error.network: Could not reach the site. Check the connection or proxy.
error.convert: This format could not be converted. Try MKV in the settings.
card.clip.tip: Download only a part of the video, without the rest of it
check.length: The length differs: {0} expected, {1} found. Choose another version if this is not the one.
check.title: This may be another song or version than the one asked for. Click to compare.
check.ambiguous: Several artists have a song with this name. Choose the one you meant.
check.nooriginal: The studio recording was not found, so this is the sound of a video.
filter.check.tip: Songs that may not be the ones asked for. They still download unless you change them.
toast.repair: A site changed, so yt-dlp is updating by itself. What failed will run again.
toast.import.none: No songs found in this file
toast.follow: Following “{0}”. New videos download by themselves.
toast.clip.bad: Check the times: they look like 1:30 or 90, and the end comes after the start
import.tip: Bring a list from anywhere: any table with names in it, your Spotify account data, an Apple Music library file, an M3U playlist, or a zip of them
import.title: Choose library files
settings.lyrics.hint: Saved next to each song, from LRCLIB
settings.playlists.hint: An .m3u8 for imported lists and playlist links
settings.skipdone.hint: Even if the file has been moved or deleted
clip.title: Only a part of it
clip.detail: Drag the frame, or type the times. Only this part is downloaded, not the whole video.
clip.added: The part downloads as a card of its own
settings.cleannames.hint: Without the video's id. Songs with the same name share one file
toast.music.down: YouTube Music search is not answering, so ordinary search is used instead
settings.parallel.label: Downloads at once
settings.clipboard.hint: Video links you copy are added by themselves
import.check.title: Check the columns
import.check.detail: This looks like a table. Say which column is which, and each line becomes a search.
import.header: The first line holds column names
import.plain.tip: Search for each line as it is
queue.copyfailed: Copy the list of what failed
toast.copied.failed: The list of what failed is copied
toast.clear.confirm: Press again to clear the whole list
error.musicservice: This service gives no files by link. Export the list of songs to a table and press Import.
toast.browser.unreadable: {0} does not let its sign-ins be read, so going on without them. Age-restricted videos may fail until you choose a browser again
toast.import.excel: Save the spreadsheet as CSV first, then import that
toast.import.big: {0} is over 50 MB, too large to be a list
toast.tools.blocked: A tool does not start even after reinstalling. An antivirus may be blocking it
tools.stalled: The download of {0} has stalled. Check the connection or the proxy.
error.filesize: This file is too large for this drive. Drives formatted as FAT32 hold at most 4 GB per file.
error.other: That did not work. Details are in the log (right-click the card to copy it).
error.proxy: Enter the proxy as http://address:port or socks5://address:port.
error.nofolder: Choose a folder to save to.
error.longfolder: The folder path is too long. Choose one closer to the top of the disk.
error.readonlyfolder: Files cannot be saved in this folder. Choose another.
